purpose: Qualification obligations for reconstructing one integrated enterprise application from local business contracts
assessment_scope: Gate definitions and complete acceptance inputs. No application gate is asserted passed by publishing this register.

assessment_status_values.not_assessed: No executed conclusion recorded for this gate and profile
assessment_status_values.blocked: Required predecessor or unresolved contract decision prevents assessment
assessment_status_values.failed: Observed execution contradicts one or more selected obligations
assessment_status_values.passed: All required evidence and pass conditions are satisfied for the declared profile
assessment_status_values.excluded: Explicitly outside a limited scope; invalid for any required gate in complete integrated scope

evaluation_rules: Evaluate predecessor graph without cycles; each required predecessor must pass for the same profile before this gate can pass.
A required evidence class must be backed by actual result records; the existence of fixture inputs is not evidence of execution.
Every pass condition and applicable case must be satisfied; illustrative selected cases do not replace all-applicable-case coverage.
Case identifiers are selected within the linked local catalog across cases, rejection_and_compatibility_cases, examples, formulas or calculations as appropriate.
All complete-integrated required gates must pass; a limited profile may exclude a gate only with explicit capability and dependency treatment.
A changed financial, permission or compatibility policy creates a new profile revision and invalidates affected results until reassessed.
Complete application qualification requires complete-integrated scope, not the sum of unrelated limited-profile claims.

required_fields.result_identifier: Stable unique identity for this assessment result
required_fields.gate_identifier: Identifier present in this gate register
required_fields.scenario_identifier: Case or supplemental scenario being executed
required_fields.profile_identifier: Named selected scope and policy set
required_fields.assessment_status: One of the defined status values
required_fields.evidence_classes: One or more actually collected classes
required_fields.acting_identity: Roles, company membership and relevant record/field grants
required_fields.initial_state: Record values and revisions, balances and pending work needed to reproduce the scenario
required_fields.operations: Ordered commands, operation identities, responses and failure injection
required_fields.observed_records: Created/changed record identities, lifecycle states and retained history
required_fields.reconciliations: Expected and actual named control measurements with currency, unit, precision and cutoff
required_fields.findings: Unresolved discrepancies or explicit empty list
required_fields.assessment_scope: Which companies, currencies, policies and operational limits were tested

conditional_fields.external_delivery: Required when an external provider participates: operation identity, accepted outcome, acknowledgement and recovery state
conditional_fields.concurrency_schedule: Required for concurrency claims: barriers, commits and competing response order
conditional_fields.recovery_measurements: Required for recovery claims: failure point, restored checkpoint, pending work and measured objectives
conditional_fields.excluded_capabilities: Required for limited scope exclusions: capability, reason and dependent-scope treatment
conditional_fields.compatibility_decisions: Required when a scenario reaches an observed anomaly or proposed correction

gates.title: Local business contracts have enough meaning to implement
pass_conditions: Every capability claimed by the selected profile resolves to local persistent records, business operations and expected outcomes.
Every reached decision predicate, helper dependency, account selection, monetary basis and failure outcome is explained or the affected gate remains blocked.
Ordered decision structures are reported as structure until the corresponding business meaning is complete.
No implementation step depends on inaccessible file content or external line coordinates.
Any stated unresolved condition is assigned a local specification decision and blocks claims that depend on it.

gates.title: Identity, amount, date and unit meanings remain stable
pass_conditions: Record identity remains stable across edits and never derives solely from a mutable display label.
Each original document line retains its parent and exact identity through downstream mapping.
Currency and quantity conversions reproduce declared input precision, intermediate rounding and final precision.
Whole-stock-unit restrictions reject fractional stock quantities produced by fractional packs.
Declared timezone and inclusive interval rules govern date calculations consistently.

gates.title: Company, record and field authority apply to every entry path
pass_conditions: The same acting identity receives the same permission outcome through ordinary forms, remote commands, imports and background initiation.
Read permission does not imply permission to use a company-restricted master in a transaction.
Denied requests do not reveal restricted field values or publish financial consequences.
Bypass roles, shared records and delegated authority are explicit profile inputs and remain auditable.

gates.title: Lifecycle and synchronous consequences are indivisible
pass_conditions: Draft, submitted and cancelled lifecycle remains distinct from business completion and hold status.
Submitted edit, amendment and cancellation follow their own permitted paths.
A stale version conflicts or revalidates before mutation.
Failure in a required synchronous stage restores parent, progress, stock, settlement, tax and ledger to their pre-operation effective state.
A declared batch with separate commits reports completed units and its recovery position explicitly.

gates.title: Domains use shared authoritative master identities
pass_conditions: Company, account, warehouse, party, employee, contact and product relationships satisfy the local record definitions.
An electronic-mail address or telephone number does not automatically collapse legally distinct parties or employees.
Customer conversion and employment changes reuse or create identities under their specified rules.
Extensions do not maintain a competing authoritative product, currency or financial account.

gates.title: Every financial event balances and retains its original context
pass_conditions: Company debits equal company credits after permitted explicit adjustments.
Over-allowance journal or payment imbalance is rejected; allowed pre-posting difference becomes a visible rounding entry.
Merging preserves original line, party, settlement, dimension, company and financial-book distinctions.
Negative-side normalization, opening entries, required dimensions, disabled accounts and frozen/closed periods produce specified outcomes.
Reversal preserves company, account and transaction measurements; reporting measurement follows its separately selected rate-date policy.
Duplicate successful submission cannot create a second financial event.

gates.title: Prices, taxes, units and commitments preserve exact decisions
pass_conditions: Tax and pricing fixture intermediate values match, including inclusive extraction, prior-row dependency, fixed residual and tax-row rounding.
Withholding preserves taxable event, withholding event, threshold history and certificate allocation.
Parent progress recomputes from qualifying descendants, clamps rows and treats all-closed and explicitly excluded rows distinctly.
Closed rows cannot be used by stale drafts or silently deleted when omitted from an edit.
Over-allowance and completion boundaries retain their strict or non-strict comparisons.

gates.title: Physical quantity, reservations and valuation reconcile
pass_conditions: Receive, deliver, return and transfer preserve stock-unit quantity independently of commercial package count.
Moving average, ordered valuation layers and standard costs each follow the selected valuation contract.
Receipt variance is not duplicated by later billing.
Backdated changes and late landed cost complete required valuation and financial recalculation before results are final.
Reservations, serial and batch selections do not permit one available quantity to satisfy incompatible simultaneous commitments.

gates.title: Claims, advances, bank and exchange effects remain distinct
pass_conditions: Complete purchase and sale sequences reconcile clearing, stock, party claims, tax, income/expense and bank.
Current invoice and term outstanding are revalidated before allocation.
Positive and negative allocation boundaries are enforced; excess funds remain an advance.
Advance application and statement matching do not post bank a second time.
Historical-rate settlement creates the required realized-exchange result and leaves no unexplained company residual.
Cancellation selects the exact claim/application consequence without reversing unrelated payments.

gates.title: Recognition, valuation, assets, budgets and closing qualify together
pass_conditions: Daily and monthly recognition preserve interval identity, draft reservations, frozen-date policy and final residual.
Each posted depreciation row has one effective journal, correct financial book and retained history; forecast alone does not affect balances.
Asset disposal, repair capitalization, adjustment and chosen cancellation policy reconcile cost, depreciation and carrying value.
Budget exact equality, warning, stop, bypass and cumulative commitment exposure are tested under the profile.
Closing rejects invalid periods, later close conflicts and stale required stock closing.
Consolidation does not claim automatic intercompany elimination absent an implemented explicit elimination contract.

pass_conditions: Nested component and output-denominator calculations preserve units and required quantities.
Partial consumption, subcontract supply, secondary outputs, process loss and actual zero-cost inputs follow their separate paths.
Operation costs and standard variances reconcile with inventory and financial posting.
Returns and cancellation preserve original materials, output identities and serial/batch allocation.

gates.title: Employment, calendars, salary and employee settlement share accounting

Salary proration, tax, benefits, overtime and deduction formulas match declared profiles and boundaries.
Preparation, salary submission, accrual journal, withholding and payment remain distinguishable events.
Expense and advance settlement preserve employee party identity and exact paid availability.
Cancellation and final employment settlement reconcile remaining obligations and asset custody.
Every declared workforce compatibility anomaly has a chosen policy and matching expectation.

Time intervals and billable remainder preserve original row identity through invoicing.
Service calendars, deadline equality, pauses, reopening and cancellation match the profile.

pass_conditions: New fields and schemas preserve required identity, lifecycle and company restrictions.
Configurable predicates have explicit supported semantics, deterministic inputs and error outcomes.
Import, export, printing, reporting and external adapters preserve declared measurements and permission checks.
Unsupported extensions fail explicitly instead of silently dropping validation or financial consequences.

gates.title: Competing operations cannot spend or publish the same remainder twice
pass_conditions: A controlled barrier demonstrates both workers read the same initial remainder before one commits.
At most the available quantity or amount becomes effective across competing workers.
Second worker revalidates, conflicts or takes only the remaining permitted amount.
One generated salary interval, recognition interval or completed operation identity cannot publish twice.
No concurrency claim is inferred merely from arithmetic or the existence of a lock elsewhere.

gates.title: External work has durable identity and an explicit recovery boundary
pass_conditions: Failed owning transaction never releases external work for delivery.
A durable operation identity survives worker restart and lost acknowledgement.
Provider-accepted work is reconciled on retry without unintended duplicate payment or communication under the declared adapter contract.
Where a provider cannot deduplicate, the profile states operator reconciliation requirements and does not claim automatic exactly-once execution.
Retry state and provider response are independently inspectable.

gates.title: Restart and restore preserve durable business meaning
pass_conditions: Restart after each declared completion boundary preserves completed units and resumes pending work without duplicate effects.
Valuation, recognition, salary and import work expose partial completion and exact recovery position.
A restored isolated environment reproduces financial and domain reconciliations and the pending-work inventory.
Measured recovery time, recoverable data interval and workload are recorded against the deployment profile.
A backup file existing is not accepted as proof that restoration succeeds.

gates.title: Reports are explainable projections of effective history
pass_conditions: Every reported amount states company, currency, date cutoff, dimensions, financial-book and cancellation treatment.
Trial balance, party outstanding, inventory value, payroll liabilities and asset balances reconcile to their named effective records.
Pending recalculation remains visible and prevents unsupported final-report claims.
Ordinary-user report and export visibility matches record and field authority.
Historical as-of enquiry and current-date authorization are not conflated.

gates.title: Complete integrated scope has executed conformance and recovery evidence
pass_conditions: Every required predecessor gate is passed for the same immutable profile and compatible implementation revision.
All fixture cases applicable to the complete profile have observed results, including declared policy alternatives.
No unresolved financial, authorization, data-loss, duplicate-effect or reconciliation finding affects the claimed scope.
Every anomaly reached by the profile has an explicit selected policy and verified expected outcome.
Measured deployment and recovery limits accompany the qualification statement.
Catalog size, translated decision counts and arithmetic passes are not represented as complete application execution.
